blocks.text: Pageant fans are in for a busy weekend with five international organizations holding their respective final competitions in three Southeast Asian countries in a span of just three days. First to crown its 2026 queen is the Universal Woman pageant in Cambodia, with the coronation date scheduled on Oct. 9. It was originally set for Oct. 10, but three other organizations had already announced that their finale will be on the same day. Representing the Philippines at the Cambodia tilt is former Miss New York USA and Miss USA semifinalist Marizza Delgado, who received her Universal Woman Philippines title at the […]...
